name: Kadeem Hardison
bio: Kadeem Hardison (born July 24, 1965) is an American actor and director. He is best known for his role Dwayne Wayne on A Different World, a spin-off of the long-running NBC sitcom The Cosby Show. He also starred in the Disney Channel series K.C. Undercover as Craig Cooper, the title character's father. ​From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia.
place: Bedford-Stuyvesant, New York City, New York, USA
